independentBasis: Make two disjoint virtual edges, A-triangle→Instrument A and B-square→Instrument B. Neither instrument is linked initially. Matching keys yield true,true; removing triangle-A yields false,true and leaves the B edge ID alone. Offering square-B to A must reject without a revision change. Reinstall triangle-A and the same A edge ID returns.
physicalLimits: Original blind-marker draw stroke is 22 mm in +Z; exact compatibility categories and 10 nm geometry comparison tolerance. No pressure path or operating parameters exist.
